# Pitch API and MCP

Pitch exposes one studio agent through REST and MCP. Each project owns a workspace, resumable conversation, preview, and outputs. Describe the outcome in the prompt and attach source material; the agent selects launch-video, browser-demo, slide-deck, recording-edit, generated-video, or generic media tools as needed.

## Authentication

Use `Authorization: Bearer pk_...` or `X-API-Key: pk_...`. Keys are user-scoped and revocation is immediate. `GET /v1/pricing` needs no key.

## Billing

Work is not priced up front. Model usage and timed host compute accrue while creation, follow-up prompts, and exports run. Host compute and provider charges are not multiplied. Reads are free. A minimum balance is required to begin work. A 402 response or MCP tool error includes the balance when available.

## REST

- `POST /v1/projects` with `{ prompt?, options?, uploads?, name? }`. Prompt may be empty when uploads are supplied. The deprecated optional `flow` field is accepted but ignored.
- `GET /v1/projects?limit=50` returns `{ data, total }`; limit must be an integer from 1 through 100.
- `GET /v1/projects/{id}` returns the project and live scenes/slides.
- `POST /v1/projects/{id}/prompt` accepts `{ text, scene?, slide?, delivery? }`; delivery defaults to queue and may be steer.
- `POST /v1/projects/{id}/export` accepts optional resolution.
- `GET /v1/projects/{id}/export` reads export status.
- `GET /v1/credits` returns balance, plan, and recent transactions.
- `GET /v1/pricing` returns usage rates and indicative export tiers.

Errors use `{ "error": { "code", "message", ... } }`. Malformed JSON is 400 invalid_request; oversized requests are 413 payload_too_large; unsupported extensions are 415 unsupported_media_type; insufficient balance is 402 insufficient_credits.

## MCP

POST `https://api.trypitch.co/mcp` using stateless Streamable HTTP. Tools:

- `create_project`: prompt, options, uploads, and optional deprecated flow hint.
- `prompt_project`: projectId, text, optional scene, slide, and delivery.
- `get_project`: projectId.
- `list_projects`: optional limit; returns data and total.
- `export_project`: projectId and optional res.
- `export_status`: projectId.
- `get_credits`.
- `get_pricing`.

Tool results contain JSON text. Failures set `isError: true`.

## Uploads

Uploads are `{ fileBase64, fileName }`. Accepted extensions: `.pdf`, `.pptx`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.webp`, `.mp4`, `.webm`, `.mov`, `.mkv`, `.avi`. Documents and images are limited to 50 MB after decoding; video is limited to 500 MB. The JSON body limit is 750 MB. Staged objects are removed when creation fails.

## Polling

Creation and prompts return 202 while work proceeds asynchronously. Poll every several seconds until status is `ready`, `failed`, or `empty`. Read the newest appropriate entry from `outputs`. There are no webhooks or idempotency keys, so list projects before retrying an uncertain create.
